instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
best_score = -1
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["yaw"] - c["object_long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:
        if c["score"] > best_score:
            best_score = c["score"]
            best_candidate = c

grasp(best_candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
if not spots["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
